announcement.quote: with respect to both the Company’s reorganization proposal and the related proposal to withdraw the Company’s election to be regulated as a Business Development Company under the Investment Company Act of 1940

deals.notes: Earliest filing in the window is already the adjournment letter (special meeting convened 2017-09-12, adjourned to 2017-09-18 for stockholders hit by Hurricanes Harvey and Irma). The 2017-09-18 8-K (0001609336-17-000026) says stockholders approved the Agreement and Plan of Reorganization (93.94% of total votes cast for) and the withdrawal of the BDC election, but no filing here states that the reorganization closed and no N-8F is shown, so the outcome is null. Neither fund is shown with an exchange listing or ticker (the target is a BDC with Commission File Number 000-55351; the Credit Fund is filed under File No. 811-23159 and its listing status is not stated), so both_listed is null.

problems: Outcome not stated after the shareholder approval on 2017-09-18; listing of both funds not stated.
